title: Python Based Open Source Permissionless Marketplace and Documentation

ms.promise:
3 outputs
・Smart-Contract Code
・Offchain Infrastructure Code
・Front-End (dApp Website) Code
ms.criteria:
・Legible/functional Smart Contract published to github
・Legible/functional Offchain Code published to github
・Legible/functional Front-End Code published to github
ms.report: The Nescrow-Catalyst code has been committed to the repository. The smart contract, offchain, and front-end code are available on the repository. A readme with links to these files has been created. Many ancillary files required for the operation of the marketplace have also been uploaded but are less directly involved with the milestone. The README has been updated with a guide for initializing and running the project as well as links and suggestions for open-source contributions. Please review https://github.com/while0x1/Nescrow-Catalyst to verify the milestone completion and authorize the Proof of Achievement.

ms.promise: A word document published on GitHub with code snippets, explanations/descriptions, references to sources (http links), and images. The documentation is a walkthrough of the entire dApp, how each piece works together, the relationships between functions/endpoints and the concepts/security considerations within the dApp. It also covers dApp Purpose and motivation.
ms.criteria:
The documentation aims to provide a description of how each software piece works together in plain english - eg) which buttons on the front-end trigger what typescript functions, how these functions work and what endpoints they subsequently call on the off-chain code and the callbacks they receive. 
Legible/Useful documentation for the project will include:
Smart Contract Walkthrough Description: explain every function in the contract. Highlight security functions within the contract and the vulnerabilities that are possible and addressed by the contract. Includes references to known vulnerabi
ms.report: The documentation has been uploaded to https://github.com/while0x1/Nescrow-Catalyst/tree/main/Documentation the documentation is available in both PDF and word (.docx) format. It can be viewed easily through the github interface in PDF format but requires downloading for the word format - the intra document links only work if you download the document(s).
